name: Amoo
summary:
Amoo is Cyan Robotics' character-based companion robot. The manufacturer describes an approximately 80 cm body with a plush, flexible covering, rounded surfaces and enclosed mechanical parts. Its design emphasizes approachable interaction and quiet operation in spaces shared with people.

Vision, sound localization and touch sensing provide inputs for responsive behavior, while bipedal movement and navigation allow the character to approach a user. Cyan's wider software architecture supports reusable character behaviors and interaction modules. Amoo is presented primarily as an embodied social

description.en:
Amoo is Cyan Robotics' character-based companion robot. The manufacturer describes an approximately 80 cm body with a plush, flexible covering, rounded surfaces and enclosed mechanical parts. Its design emphasizes approachable interaction and quiet operation in spaces shared with people.

Vision, sound localization and touch sensing provide inputs for responsive behavior, while bipedal movement and navigation allow the character to approach a user. Cyan's wider software architecture supports reusable character behaviors and interaction modules. Amoo is presented primarily as an embodied social character, with applications extending from companionship to themed hospitality and brand experiences.
